name: subx-functional-line
preamble: Refined flat geometric line icons for a professional dark subtitle editor; cool neutral light-grey strokes on medium grey, no fill or effects.

construction.grid: 24 unit keyline with 80 percent live area
construction.stroke: uniform 2 unit stroke, rounded caps and joins
construction.detail_budget: one recognizable metaphor with at most four parts
construction.color_rule: neutral light foreground; UI applies #173E76 for active state
construction.shared_parts: reuse document, track and frame shapes
construction.motif: precise editing cuts and timeline lines
